name: Graubünden
flagName: Flag of the Canton of Graubünden
summary: A square combining the arms of the three medieval leagues: the black and white Grey League, the ibex of the League of God's House, and the blue and gold cross of the League of the Ten Jurisdictions.
origin: The three leagues allied in the 15th century and formed the Free State of the Three Leagues. It became the canton of Graubünden (Grisons) in 1803.

symbols.name: Cross
symbols.description: A quartered blue and gold cross.
symbols.meaning: The League of the Ten Jurisdictions.

facts: It is Switzerland's largest canton and the only one with three official languages: German, Romansh and Italian.
The ibex is also its canton animal.
clues: A flag combining three historic leagues, with an ibex.
Switzerland's largest canton, with three official languages.
